pages.action: Mouse steps towards the cottage while its curved tail sways.
Mouse tilts its head and sniffs through the open door.
Puppy wags its tail to invite Mouse into the basket; Mouse nods.
Mouse bounces above the puddle and muddy splashes jump after each bounce.
Parrot opens and flutters a wing in welcome while Mouse looks up.
The dream parrot rocks as it calls and tall forest leaves rustle around sleeping Mouse.
Fish swims across the bowl and small bubbles rise towards the surface.
Reeds sway in the water and bubbles rise through Mouse’s cold, wet dream.
The fireplace flame flickers upward as Mouse settles on a dry cushion.
Mouse takes a small step into the snug space between the books.
The quilt rises and falls with Mouse’s breathing, and a soft dream heart floats upward.
